constraints.name: environments_issuer_host_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((issuer_host = lower(issuer_host)) AND (POSITION(('://'::text) IN (issuer_host)) = 0) AND (POSITION(('/'::text) IN (issuer_host)) = 0) AND (POSITION(('?'::text) IN (issuer_host)) = 0) AND (POSITION(('#'::text) IN (issuer_host)) = 0)))

constraints.name: organization_admin_access_grants_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((active AND (revision = 1) AND (revocation_key IS NULL) AND (revocation_digest IS NULL)) OR ((NOT active) AND (revision = 2) AND (revocation_key IS NOT NULL) AND (revocation_digest IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: organization_authority_event_scope
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((organization_id IS NULL) AND (event_type ~~ 'domain.%'::text)) OR ((organization_id IS NOT NULL) AND (event_type !~~ 'domain.%'::text))))

constraints.name: organization_identity_requests_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'pending'::text) AND (result IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'completed'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(result) = 'object'::text))))

constraints.name: organization_identity_requests_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((delivery_revision = 0) AND (delivered_at IS NULL) AND (capability_hash IS NULL) AND (delivery_outcome = 'unclaimed'::text)) OR ((delivery_revision > 0) AND (delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AND (capability_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (delivery_outcome <> 'unclaimed'::text))))

constraints.name: organization_invitations_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((delivery_revision = 0) AND (delivered_at IS NULL) AND (capability_hash IS NULL)) OR ((delivery_revision > 0) AND (delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AND (capability_hash IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: organization_invitations_check2

constraints.name: subject_ownership_adoptions_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'fresh'::text) AND (maintenance_reference IS NULL) AND (manifest_sha256 IS NULL) AND (inventory_sha256 IS NULL) AND (receipt_data IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'legacy'::text) AND (maintenance_reference IS NOT NULL) AND (manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (inventory_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (manifest_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (inventory_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (receipt_data IS NOT NULL))))
